blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Bangsamoro Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua created two advisory offices on Thursday under the Office of the Chief Minister (OCM) to strengthen the autonomous region’s moral governance framework and improve coordination between the Bangsamoro Government’s Cabinet and Parliament. Macacua issued executive orders creating the Office of the Senior Adviser to the Chief Minister (OSACM)
